name: Kinovel Noir
source:
Rita, a young photographer, is found dead allegedly after she committed suicide. Her friend Joel doesn't beleive this version of things and will soon discover that she has been killed because of a picture she has taken.

[From [url=https://el-jo66.itch.io/kinovel-noir]Itch.io[/url]]
